req.title: Player creation persists to DB
req.statement: The system shall commit newly created players to the players table so subsequent GET requests return them.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-019 requires that POST /players/ commits a new player to the DB so a subsequent GET returns it. Tests must cover: (1) positive EP — valid new player persists and GET confirms it; (2) negative NEG — duplicate squad number returns 409 and is not double-inserted; (3) boundary BVA — squad number at the boundary of existing data (27, the first unused number) persists correctly; (4) STC — state transition from absent→present verified via GET by squad number; (5) DT — missing required field returns 422 and nothing is persisted. Each test uses exact status codes, exact field values, and relative count assertions to kill operator-flip and constant-bump mutations.

tests.name: test_post_player_persists_and_get_returns_it
preconditions: DB contains exactly 26 pre-loaded players (squad numbers 1-26)
Squad number 99 does not exist in the DB
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squad_number=99
Assert GET returns HTTP 200 and payload matches created player
expected: POST response body contains id (UUID), first_name, last_name, squad_number=99
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_persists_and_get_returns_it():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    body = post_r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert "id" in body
    assert len(body["id"]) == 36
    get_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/99")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    get_body = get_r.json()
    assert get_body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert get_body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert get_body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert get_body["id"] == body["id"]
    client.delete("/players/squadnumber/99")

tests.name: test_post_duplicate_squad_number_returns_409
actions: GET /players/squadnumber/1 to confirm original player unchanged
expected: GET /players/squadnumber/1 still returns the original player (Anjali Banerjee)
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_duplicate_squad_number_returns_409():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Duplicate",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 1,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 409
    get_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/1")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    get_body = get_r.json()
    assert get_body["squadNumber"] == 1
    assert get_body["firstName"] == "Anjali"
    assert get_body["lastName"] == "Banerjee"

tests.name: test_post_player_at_boundary_squad_number_27
preconditions: Squad number 27 does not exist (first unused number above pre-loaded data)
actions: GET /players/ to confirm count is now 27
expected: GET /players/ count increases from 26 to 27 (len(after) == len(before) + 1)
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_at_boundary_squad_number_27():
    before_r = client.get("/players/")
    assert before_r.status_code == 200
    before_count = len(before_r.json())
    assert before_count == 26
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Boundary",
        "lastName": "Test",
        "squadNumber": 27,
        "position": "Centre-Back"
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    body = post_r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 27
    get_sq_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/27")
    assert get_sq_r.status_code == 200
    assert get_sq_r.json()["squadNumber"] == 27
    assert get_sq_r.json()["firstName"] == "Boundary"
    client.delete("/players/squadnumber/27")

tests.name: test_post_player_state_transition_absent_to_present
preconditions: Squad number 50 does not exist in the DB
actions: Verify returned id matches POST response id
expected: Subsequent GET returns 200 with same id as POST response
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_state_transition_absent_to_present():
    pre_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/50")
    assert pre_r.status_code == 404
    payload = {
        "firstName": "State",
        "lastName": "Transition",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Left-Back",
        "team": "Test FC",
        "league": "Test League"
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    created_id = post_r.json()["id"]
    post_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/50")
    assert post_r.status_code == 200
    fetched = post_r.json()
    assert fetched["id"] == created_id
    assert fetched["squadNumber"] == 50
    assert fetched["firstName"] == "State"
    assert fetched["lastName"] == "Transition"
    client.delete("/players/squadnumber/50")

tests.name: test_post_player_missing_required_field_returns_422
actions: POST /players/ with payload missing required 'position' field
GET /players/ to confirm count is still 26 (nothing persisted)
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_missing_required_field_returns_422():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Missing",
        "lastName": "Position",
        "squadNumber": 88
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 422
    get_r = client.get("/players/")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    assert len(get_r.json()) == 26
    absent_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/88")
    assert absent_r.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_post_player_response_location_header_and_all_fields
preconditions: Squad number 77 does not exist in the DB
actions: POST /players/ with a fully-populated payload (all optional fields set)
Assert all response fields match input exactly
expected: All fields in response body match submitted values
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_response_location_header_and_all_fields():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Full",
        "middleName": "Middle",
        "lastName": "Fields",
        "dateOfBirth": "1990-06-15T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 77,
        "position": "Right Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "RW",
        "team": "Test United",
        "league": "Premier League",
        "starting11": True
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    assert post_r.headers.get("location") == "/players/squadnumber/77"
    body = post_r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Full"
    assert body["middleName"] == "Middle"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Fields"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 77
    assert body["position"] == "Right Winger"
    assert body["abbrPosition"] == "RW"
    assert body["team"] == "Test United"
    assert body["league"] == "Premier League"
    assert body["starting11"] == True
    client.delete("/players/squadnumber/77")
